blockers: Resolve all held visits before releasing a complete capacity comparison. Partial station statistics exclude held rows.
method: MiniLM embeddings suggest station identity; human review is mandatory. Deterministic half-open interval sweeps count concurrent completed visits. Exhaustive integer allocation minimizes excess occupancy person-minutes, then seats used, within the budget. First-station baseline puts the entire budget at the first supplied station. Results describe supplied historical visits, not predicted queue lengths or future staffing productivity. Seats are waiting/occupancy spaces, not service workers. No durations are shortened and no future demand is predicted.
